scenes.headline: How an agent rewrites the optimizer while the model trains
scenes.sub: Two small programs, one coding agent, one training run
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lanyard! Here's how a coding agent rewrites an optimizer while the model trains.

scenes.text: The optimizer becomes code an agent keeps rewriting: one program watches the run, the other makes every update.
scenes.say: The optimizer becomes code an agent keeps rewriting. One program watches the run. The other makes every update.

steps.say: Your training loop stays the same. At every update, the updater program turns gradients into weight changes.
Every fifty updates, the analysis program reads losses and gradients and writes a report.
At each decision, the agent reads those reports, and may rewrite the analysis.
Or it rewrites the updater: new learning rates, a different rule per layer, a spike guard.

items.say: The wrapper compares the agent's files with the running ones.
A changed updater is built from the old one, keeping momentum.
It runs on trial for twenty updates. A crash on its first update is undone exactly.
A bad idea that does not crash waits for the next decision.

left.title: A fixed recipe
items: Same rule until the last update
left.say: A fixed recipe is decided up front and never changes.

right.title: A reactive optimizer
right.say: A reactive one reads its own probes and changes rules mid-run.

steps.say: Here a tenth of the labels are wrong. The plain recipe, in grey, memorizes them, and test loss climbs.
The agent, in blue, sees dev loss rise, raises its learning rate, and averages its weights.

scenes.title: Ahead of the best off-the-shelf recipe
scenes.say: Against the best recipe off the shelf, the margins are small in three language settings and clear in one.

scenes.label: agent cost for about 100 decisions on LightningDiT-XL/1
scenes.say: The agent is cheap. One image model run paid six dollars forty-two for it, beside seventy-four GPU hours.

scenes.text: A reactive optimizer repairs recipes that do not transfer. On a recipe someone already tuned, expect a tie.
scenes.mark: repairs recipes that do not transfer
scenes.say: Remember this. A reactive optimizer repairs recipes that do not transfer. On a tuned recipe, expect a tie.

recap: Two programs: one watches, one updates
Edits run on a twenty-update trial
Big gains over its start, small over the best
scenes.say: Two programs, a trial for every edit, and gains where nobody tuned a recipe.
